title: Tenure Goodwill Table for Rental Property Service Contracts Billing Corrections
content:
**Goodwill rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts re-rating correction carries a tenure goodwill rate set by how long before the correction is posted the contract was originally purchased.

| Original purchase date | Tenure goodwill |
|---|---|
| 1095 days or more before the correction is posted | 0.05 |
| 730 to 1094 days before | 0.03 |
| otherwise | 0 |

The original purchase date is the start date on the contract; the days are calendar days from it to the posting day.

**How the rate acts.** Every goodwill rate on a re-rating correction is added to one in a single sum, and the correction is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

| Days from the original purchase date | Tenure goodwill |
|---|---|
| 729 | 0 |
| 730 | 0.03 |
| 1094 | 0.03 |
| 1095 | 0.05 |
